title: Slack CLI app on an Enterprise org installs but never receives events
symptoms: slack install or slack run succeeds on an Enterprise organization but no events arrive
cause: On an Enterprise organization the app needs organization-wide installation enabled in its manifest. Without it the app installs but gets no events. CLI v4.12.0 added a check that stops before creating the app.
fix: Set org_deploy_enabled to true in the manifest settings and upgrade the CLI to v4.12.0 or later so the missing setting is caught up front.
affected: Slack CLI before v4.12.0 (released 2026-10-30) on Enterprise organizations
